text:
alyssa: Heads up — kicked off a recompute for EU agg window 2026-03-18 due to late events. It's queued in backfill-coordinator and eating slots. Console shows other replays getting pushed to low priority. Anyone seeing unexpected throttles?

ben: saw it. which policy did you pick? default-preempt or non-preempt?

alyssa: default-preempt; wanted it to finish quickly. but it's saturating dedicated pool.

mira: we should use 'fair-share:telemetry-recompute' — caps per-customer concurrency and respects reserved capacity. config lives in /configs/backfill/policies.yaml

ben: we don't have that policy wired into the console UX yet. dropdown only shows 'preempt' and 'respect-quota'.

kevin: console rollout UX still missing policy mapping. @mira can you add mapping? otherwise ops will flip wrong toggles during incident.

mira: on it. quick patch: add option label 'fair-share recompute (recommended)'. PR incoming.

backfill-bot: Job 56789 started • target: EU agg • policy: default-preempt • slots: 120 • ETA: unknown

alyssa: also FYI billing: recompute jobs currently bill to 'console.recompute' meter which counts toward customer quota and skews alerting.

julie: that's why product teams see quota spike and flip off telemetry ingest. we need a separate internal meter for platform backfills.

ben: agree. route internal backfills to org 'redwood-infra' so customers don't hit quotas. preserve cost center metadata for finance.

mira: I'll add routing rule: if job.metadata.source=platform-backfill -> quota_account=infra. also throttle to 20% of dedicated pool with limited burst.

kevin: we also need a recompute overlay on telemetry dashboard that shows 'recompute delta' vs 'normal ingest' per hour so PMs aren't confused.

alyssa: can we add tooltip: 'recompute events are historic replays and should not be counted as new user activity'? helps reduce support noise.

julie: :thumbsup: will update dashboard note. request: run a small canary with kv_rehydrate=false first to save IO and avoid double-counting.

mira: canary makes sense. start with 5 shards, policy=fair-share, kv=false. if green, scale to 50.

backfill-bot: Job 56790 (canary) queued • shards:5 • policy: fair-share • kv_rehydrate: false

ben: if canary passes, add console rollout flag 'start-canary' that flips to 'scale' after approval. UX should show canary metrics inline and a one-click promote.

kevin: I'll open a small RFC to update console rollout controls + meter mapping. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-1234

julie: also add temporary alert suppression so SRE doesn't get paged for expected recompute surge. run: /ops/alerts set-snooze recompute_jobs 3h

ops-bot: Alert suppression set for recompute_jobs by julie for 3h

alyssa: thanks all. plan: mira PR policy & mapping by EOD, kevin open RFC, julie update dashboard & suppression, ben monitor canary. I'll report back at 10:30 PT.

backfill-bot: Job 56790 started • status: running • shards:5 • policy: fair-share
